question: For veg whsle data, can you analyze our financial performance over the years 2020 to 2023? I need insights into the average wholesale price, maximum wholesale price, minimum wholesale price, wholesale price difference, total wholesale price, total selling price, average loss rate, total loss, and profit for each category within each year. Round all calculated values to two decimal places.
sql:
WITH wholesale AS (
    SELECT 
        SUBSTR(w.whsle_date, 1, 4) AS year,
        c.category_name,
        ROUND(AVG(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS avg_wholesale_price,
        ROUND(MAX(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS max_wholesale_price,
        ROUND(MIN(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS min_wholesale_price,
        ROUND(MAX(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") - MIN(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS wholesale_price_difference,
        ROUND(SUM(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS total_wholesale_price
    FROM veg_whsle_df w
    JOIN veg_cat c ON w.item_code = c.item_code
    WHERE SUBSTR(w.whsle_date, 1, 4) BETWEEN '2020' AND '2023'
    GROUP BY SUBSTR(w.whsle_date, 1, 4), c.category_name
),
transactions AS (
    SELECT 
        SUBSTR(t.txn_date, 1, 4) AS year,
        c.category_name,
        ROUND(SUM(t."qty_sold(kg)" * t."unit_selling_px_rmb/kg"), 2) AS total_selling_price
    FROM veg_txn_df t
    JOIN veg_cat c ON t.item_code = c.item_code
    WHERE SUBSTR(t.txn_date, 1, 4) BETWEEN '2020' AND '2023'
      AND t."sale/return" = 'sale'
    GROUP BY SUBSTR(t.txn_date, 1, 4), c.category_name
),
loss_rates AS (
    SELECT 
        c.category_name,
        ROUND(AVG("loss_rate_%"), 2) AS avg_loss_rate
    FROM veg_loss_rate_df
    JOIN veg_cat c ON veg_loss_rate_df.item_code = c.item_code
    GROUP BY c.category_name
)
SELECT 
    w.year,
    w.category_name,
    w.avg_wholesale_price,
    w.max_wholesale_price,
    w.min_wholesale_price,
    w.wholesale_price_difference,
    w.total_wholesale_price,
    t.total_selling_price,
    l.avg_loss_rate,
    ROUND(t.total_selling_price * l.avg_loss_rate / 100, 2) AS total_loss,
    ROUND(t.total_selling_price - (t.total_selling_price * l.avg_loss_rate / 100), 2) AS profit
FROM wholesale w
JOIN transactions t ON w.year = t.year AND w.category_name = t.category_name
JOIN loss_rates l ON w.category_name = l.category_name
ORDER BY w.year, w.category_name

function.name: run_sql_query
function.arguments:
{"sql": "-- Build wholesale metrics per category per year
WITH wholesale AS (
    SELECT 
        SUBSTR(w.whsle_date, 1, 4) AS year,
        c.category_name,
        ROUND(AVG(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS avg_wholesale_price,
        ROUND(MAX(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS max_wholesale_price,
        ROUND(MIN(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS min_wholesale_price,
        ROUND(MAX(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") - MIN(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS wholesale_price_difference,
        ROUND(SUM(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS total_wholesale_price
    FROM veg_whsle_df w
    JOIN veg_cat c ON w.item_code = c.item_code
    WHERE SUBSTR(w.whsle_date, 1, 4) BETWEEN '2020' AND '2023'
    GROUP BY SUBSTR(w.whsle_date, 1, 4), c.category_name
),
transactions AS (
    SELECT 
        SUBSTR(t.txn_date, 1, 4) AS year,
        c.category_name,
        ROUND(SUM(t."qty_sold(kg)" * t."unit_selling_px_rmb/kg"), 2) AS total_selling_price
    FROM veg_txn_df t
    JOIN veg_cat c ON t.item_code = c.item_code
    WHERE SUBSTR(t.txn_date, 1, 4) BETWEEN '2020' AND '2023'
      AND t."sale/return" = 'sale'
    GROUP BY SUBSTR(t.txn_date, 1, 4), c.category_name
),
loss_rates AS (
    SELECT 
        c.category_name,
        ROUND(AVG(l.loss_rate_%), 2) AS avg_loss_rate
    FROM veg_loss_rate_df l
    JOIN veg_cat c ON l.item_code = c.item_code
    GROUP BY c.category_name
)
SELECT 
    w.year,
    w.category_name,
    w.avg_wholesale_price,
    w.max_wholesale_price,
    w.min_wholesale_price,
    w.wholesale_price_difference,
    w.total_wholesale_price,
    t.total_selling_price,
    l.avg_loss_rate,
    ROUND(t.total_selling_price * l.avg_loss_rate / 100, 2) AS total_loss,
    ROUND(t.total_selling_price - (t.total_selling_price * l.avg_loss_rate / 100), 2) AS profit
FROM wholesale w
JOIN transactions t ON w.year = t.year AND w.category_name = t.category_name
JOIN loss_rates l ON w.category_name = l.category_name
ORDER BY w.year, w.category_name", "preview_rows": 25}
